1. Executive Overview & Two Distinct Operational Streams Core Architecture

SolarKits Warehouse Panel me do bilkul transparent aur independent streams banayi gayi hain taaki stock refill karne aur customer orders deliver karne me zero confusion rahe:

Stream A: Customer Sales Order Delivery Flow

Route: New Orders → BOS Kit Assembly → Out for Delivery → Track Delivery & POD

Account Manager dwara confirm kiye gaye specific customer orders ka material inward verify karna, BOS Kit buffer stock se allocate ya assemble karna, E-Way Bill aur gadi photo ke sath security gate clearance dena, aur destination par customer OTP se delivery confirm karna.

Stream B: Warehouse Bulk Stock Replenishment

Route: Material Inward (Accounts Indents & OEM Purchase Orders)

Warehouse godown me panels, inverters, cables aur structures ka bulk stock replenish karna. Gate par aane wale truck/fleet ki transport details verify karna, QR gun scanner ya gate challan se inward karke live inventory me stock add karna.

1 Stage 1: New Orders Queue (Customer Order Intake & Verification)
Account Manager se Kya Details Aati Hain? URL: /warehouse-management-panel/new-orders

Account Manager dwara order approve hote hi New Orders queue me complete customer order dossier synchronize ho jata hai:

1. Customer & Location

  • Client / EPC Name & Contact Phone
  • Delivery Address, District & Pincode
  • State Route Filter (Maharashtra, MP, etc.)

2. Financials & Payment

  • Payment Status Badge (PAYMENT DONE)
  • Advance % Received & Balance Amount
  • Discrepancy Alerts (e.g. 1 DISCREPANCY)

3. SLA & Operational Status

  • Overdue SLA timer (e.g. OVERDUE (2D))
  • Inward Progress Bar (e.g. 42 / 44 Pcs - 95%)
  • Target Dispatch Date & Priority
Warehouse Action: "INWARD MATERIAL" Button Dabakar Kya Hota Hai? Inward Verification Modal

Order card par blue "INWARD MATERIAL" button dabane par modal khulta hai jisme warehouse operator yeh kaam karta hai:

⚡ Fill All Pending Button: Operator ko har component par quantity type nahi karni padti. Ek click me saari expected quantities received me fill ho jati hain.
QC Damage & Shortage Counters: Agar transit me koi component tuta ya gayab mila, toh Damage/Missing counters me quantity daalte hi system discrepancy report save kar leta hai.

Rack Location & Status Progression

Storage Rack / Bay: Material kis godown rack par rakha gaya (e.g. BAY-A1-04 ya RACK-C2).

Partial vs Complete Inward:

  • Partial Inward: Agar kuch components pending hain, card par orange badge PARTIALLY INWARDED (95%) dikhta hai.
  • Complete Inward: Saara maal milte hi green badge INWARD DONE (100%) ho jata hai aur "SEND FOR BOS KIT ASSEMBLY" button active ho jata hai!

2 Stage 2: BOS Kit Assembly & Warehouse Buffer Stock Allocation
Boss Requirement: Ready Buffer Stock Allocation vs Live Assembly URL: /warehouse-management-panel/bos-kit-assembly

BOS (Balance of System) Kit me DCDB box, ACDB box, MC4 connectors, Solar DC wire, Earthing rod aur Lightning Arrester aate hain. Yeh screen 2 powerful parts me banti hui hai:

PART 1: 📦 ORDER-SPECIFIC ASSEMBLY & STOCK ALLOCATION

1-Click Fast-Track Allocation (Ready Stock Se):

Top me green pill dikhati hai: "WH Ready Stock: 7 Kits Available". Har customer order card par purple banner aata hai: "Warehouse Buffer Stock: 7 Kits Ready in WH".

Green Action Button: Operator "⚡ ALLOCATE FROM READY STOCK" button dabata hai. System warehouse ready batch (e.g. WH-BOS-5KW-B04) order ke sath bind karke order ko bina kisi delay ke turant "Kit Ready for Dispatch" mark kar deta hai!

PART 2: 🏭 WAREHOUSE STOCK BUFFER PRE-ASSEMBLY (MAKE-TO-STOCK)

Advance Me Ready Stock Banakar Rakhna:

Warehouse team idle time me inwarded raw materials (rails, clamps, cables, boxes) se advance me 3 Standard Catalog Models pre-assemble karke buffer store karti hai:

  • 5kW Standard Residential Solar BOS Kit: 4 Kits Ready in Bay 2
  • 3kW Residential Compact Solar BOS Kit: 2 Kits Ready in Bay 1
  • 10kW Commercial Solar BOS Kit: 1 Kit Ready in Bay 3

4 Stage 4: Out for Delivery Station (Vehicle Loading & Gate Clearance)
Orders Awaiting Dispatch & 4-Step Horizontal Gate Clearance URL: /warehouse-management-panel/out-for-delivery

BOS Kit ready hone ke baad order Out for Delivery queue me aata hai. Security gate clearance ke liye 4 stages poori ki jaati hain:

Step 1: Delivery Method & Grouping

  • Manual Delivery: Custom vehicle aur driver arrange karna.
  • Auto Delivery: Fleet matching system.
  • Ungroup EPCs: Consolidated packages ko route-wise alag gadi me bhejne ke liye split karna.

Step 2: Transport & Vehicle Details

  • Recommended Vehicle: Tata Ace (1.5T) ya 14ft Eicher (4.0T).
  • Vehicle Number, Driver Name & Mobile.
  • Transporter Agency & Bilty / LR Docket No.

Step 3: E-Way Bill Verification

  • Account Manager ko 1-click E-Way Bill request bhejna.
  • 12-Digit E-Way Bill number & validity verify karna.

Step 4: Gate Clearance & Rear Photo Upload

  • Gadi ke piche loaded maal aur tamper seal ka Rear Photo upload karna.
  • Security Gate Pass sign-off karke "Initiate Dispatch" dabana.

5 Stage 5: Track Delivery & Dual Proof of Delivery (POD) Hub
Live Fleet Monitoring & Customer Handover Verification URL: /warehouse-management-panel/track-delivery

Gadi warehouse se nikalte hi Track Delivery hub me live track hoti hai. Delivery Journey Timeline 4 stages dikhati hai:

1. Material Inward (100% BOS Verified) ✓ 2. E-Way Bill Issued (AM Approved) ✓ 3. In Transit (Loaded & Dispatched) 🚚 4. Handover & POD (Pending Arrival) ⏳

HANDOVER METHOD 1: 🔐 Secure 6-Digit OTP Handover

Truck customer location par pahuchte hi system se customer mobile par OTP jata hai. Customer items verify karke driver ko OTP deta hai. Portal me OTP match hote hi delivery 100% digital proof ke sath verify ho jati hai.

HANDOVER METHOD 2: 📸 Destination Photo & Signed Challan

Agar remote area me mobile network issue ho, toh driver site par panels/boxes utarne ka Destination Photo leta hai aur customer se signed & stamped delivery challan upload karta hai.

Executive Summary for Management & Boss 100% Production Ready

Yeh naya end-to-end flow SolarKits warehouse operations ko complete transparency, zero discrepancy, aur maximum speed provide karta hai:
1. Buffer Fast-Tracking: Warehouse me 7 kits buffer ready hone se manual assembly bypass hoti hai aur 1-click me kit allocate ho jati hai.
2. Logistics Transparency: Accounts se aane wale har indent ki vehicle, driver phone aur LR gate pass live dikhti hai.
3. Zero Transit Fraud: E-Way bill verification, rear loading photo, aur destination OTP/Photo POD se fake delivery ya transit dispute ka risk bilkul khatam ho jata hai.
